title: Hydrogel with cell-cell adhesion cues enhances neural regeneration.
authors: Tang, Xiaoxuan; Zhang, Shuxuan; Liu, Mengke; Liang, Yuxin; Fan, Yulan; Sun, Xinyue; He, Chang; Yang, Xuewa; Zhu, Rong; Jin, Xiaoling; Zhuang, QianXing; Ge, Yifan; Ling, Jue; Yang, Yumin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水凝胶中细胞-细胞粘附信号促进神经再生，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cell-cell adhesion is crucial for maintaining cell functions and the integrity of tissue structure in organisms. However, cell-cell adhesion cues have not been effectively replicated in biomaterials and the associated mechanisms that enhance neural regeneration remained largely unexplored. Here, we present a diffusive N-cadherin functionalized hydrogel system, which provided cell-cell adhesion cues to modulate intercellular communications to significantly promote the formation of active neural network via thrombospondin-1 mediated neural communication and activation of TGF-beta/Smad pathway. The dynamic assembly of N-cadherin at cell-hydrogel interface driven by adhered neurons effectively facilitated the reshaping of membrane protrusions to initiate intercellular adherens junctions. Further, this hydrogel system promisingly promoted neurological function recovery in rats following traumatic brain injury. Our study provides the principle of replicating diffusive cell adhesion molecules to mediate cell-cell adhesion in hydrogels, which may have broad applications in developing engineered biomaterials aimed at modulating cell fates in regeneration of various tissues.
abstract_zh: 细胞间粘附对于维持生物体内细胞功能和组织结构完整性至关重要。然而，细胞间粘附信号在生物材料中尚未被有效复制，且其增强神经再生的相关机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们提出了一种扩散性N-钙粘蛋白功能化水凝胶系统，该系统提供细胞间粘附信号以调节细胞间通讯，通过血小板反应蛋白-1介导的神经通讯和TGF-beta/Smad通路激活，显著促进活性神经网络的形成。由粘附神经元驱动的细胞-水凝胶界面处N-钙粘蛋白的动态组装，有效促进了膜突起的重塑，以启动细胞间粘附连接。此外，该水凝胶系统在大鼠创伤性脑损伤后有望促进神经功能恢复。我们的研究提供了在水凝胶中复制扩散性细胞粘附分子以介导细胞间粘附的原理，这可能对开发旨在调节各种组织再生中细胞命运的工程生物材料具有广泛的应用前景。
